name: web-four-kpi-stat-cards-with-delta-arrows-beside-heading-block
title: Section with a dark 'Platform' pill and headline beside a 2x2 grid of KPI cards showing values, deltas and arrows
whatItIs: A white page with a dark pill 'Platform', a tightly tracked headline 'This is the start of something new', a grey paragraph and a 2x2 grid of soft-shadow cards, each with a small arrow (dark up, red down), a big figure (500.000, 20.105, $523.520, $1052), a green or red delta and a grey label.
whatItMeans: Confident and clean; large numbers with small deltas read as a quick pulse of the business.
techniques: Show KPIs as large numerals with small deltas.

vocabulary.definition: A small change indicator such as +8%.
Letter spacing reduced for a dense headline.
A small dark capsule labelling a section.
